summary: The PR addresses the issue of adding a nullable OneToOneField crashing on SQLite by modifying the schema editor logic. The provided reproduction scripts help understand the context but are not part of the review scope.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new condition in the `add_field` method without updating the docstring to reflect the new check for `field.unique` and `field.one_to_one`. This could confuse future maintainers.

The addition of multiple reproduction scripts (`reproduce.py`, `reproduce2.py`, `reproduce3.py`, `reproduce4.py`) is not necessary for the core fix and could be considered scope creep. Only one or two representative scripts might suffice.
